title: Prepare raster assets
summary: Perform bounded deterministic alpha trimming, explicit resizing, or placement of a caller-supplied brand mark on a local raster and write a PNG result.

operations.title: Trim transparent bounds
operations.description: Crop only transparent outer pixels according to an explicit alpha threshold and optional padding. This operation does not infer or remove a visual background.

operations.title: Resize raster
operations.description: Render an exact caller-supplied output size using contain, centered cover, or stretch semantics.

operations.title: Apply a supplied brand mark
operations.description: Place a caller-supplied logo or authorization mark using a stable nine-anchor, margin, opacity, and maximum-width contract. This operation does not choose a mark or decide which assets may be shared.
